newsitem.title: CANADA: Hicks, Muse bids for Circo Craft.
newsitem.headline: Hicks, Muse bids for Circo Craft.

text.p: Circo Craft Co Inc said on Thursday that a newly-created affiliate of Hicks, Muse, Tate and Furst Inc had made a C$11 a share offer for all the issued and outstanding common shares of Circo Craft.

Circo Craft said its board recommended the Hicks, Muse offer. H.-K. Huhlegg, chairman, president and chief executive of Circo Craft, has informed the company's board of directors that he will be tendering his 24.3 percent indirect interest in Circo Craft to the Hicks, Muse offer.
The other Circo Craft directors will also be tendering their shares to the Hicks, Muse offer, the company said.
The board's recommendation and tendering of the shares held by Muhlegg and other directors is subject to the company not receiving a higher offer before the expiry of the Hicks, Muse offer.

Circo Craft said it has agreed to reimburse Hick Muse its expenses under certain circumstances or to pay an incremental fee of up to C$0.31 a share plus 20 percent of any excess consideration per share paid to Circo Craft shareholders between C$11 and C$12.50 a share.
Circo Craft said the Hicks Muse offer will be mailed to shareholders no later than September 9, but it did not immediately specify the expiry date of the offer.
Hicks Muse is a private investment firm with offices in the United States and Mexico.
